title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct half-life of U-235 as 10^9 years.

title: Correct Value
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize that the half-life is approximately 7 x 10^8 years, which is closest to 10^9 years.

title: Understanding Half-life
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the concept of half-life in radioactive decay.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that the units of years are consistently applied throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as misreading the half-life values or confusing them with other isotopes.
